info.title: RupeeRise API
info.description: Financial literacy learning platform: fictional simulations, assessments, adaptive learning and educator analytics. Educational use only; not financial advice.

post.description: Create a student account. No email, phone or real-world ID is collected.

Join an organisation as an educator with its invitation token.

The organisation is taken from the invite. Nothing the caller types can choose, name or
match an organisation, so there is no way to attach to someone else's.
Rotate the refresh token and issue a fresh access token (cookie sessions only).
End this session on the server (the cookies alone are not what makes it end).
Change the password. Every existing session is revoked; this device gets a new one.

post.description:
Join a class by code. A student belongs to one organisation at a time.

A code from a different organisation is refused with the same message as an unknown code,
so codes cannot be used to probe other organisations. Leaving an organisation is an
explicit act (``POST /students/me/organization/leave``).

Leave your organisation and all its classes, so you could join a different one.

Their educators lose sight of your data immediately. The move is written to an audit table.

delete.description:
Permanently delete the student's account and all learning data (privacy right).

Irreversible, so it needs the current password even though the caller is signed in.

AuthOut.title: AuthOut
AuthOut.description:
Result of login/register/refresh. The session itself lives in HttpOnly cookies.

``access_token`` is present only for non-browser clients that send ``X-Auth-Mode: bearer``.

EducatorRegister.title: EducatorRegister
EducatorRegister.description:
Educators join an existing organisation with a single-organisation invitation token.

There is deliberately no organisation field: the organisation comes from the invite.
